name: _amp_foreach_non_finite_check_and_unscale_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_amp_foreach_non_finite_check_and_unscale_(Tensor(a!)[] self, Tensor(b!) found_inf, Tensor inv_scale) -> (). Unscales finite gradient values in place, preserves non-finite values, and records non-finite input in found_inf. Tests cover float16/float32, finite/inf/nan, preexisting found_inf, empty lists and tensors, invalid input type, void return, every list element identity/storage/value, found_inf mutation, and inv_scale non-mutation.
